HF18.3 fixes launcher startup/ShowDialog crashes caused by malformed legacy discovery objects under StrictMode and prevents stale unmarked Lucid preferences from silently replacing freshly installed ELYSIUM binaries. Explicit current user engine selections remain honored. A packaged UNCANNY.exe launcher survival smoke test is part of the Windows release gate.

HF18 rendering, Universal API Bridge behavior, WARP quality contracts, PCSX2, REVENANT, and the clean runtime/Tools public package layout are preserved.

Real-game behavior remains title/GPU/driver specific.
